Celebrations in Smoke#000.src: The dagger is lightly stained with blood.
Celebrations in Smoke#000.dst: A adaga tem leves manchas de sangue.

Celebrations in Smoke#002.src: That should be enough to go off if you can find a member of the Kalkalrah clan. If you want to get more information though, you can continue the interrogation.
Celebrations in Smoke#002.dst: Isso deve bastar para seguir a pista se você encontrar alguém do clã Kalkalrah. Mas, se quiser mais informações, pode continuar o interrogatório.

Celebrations in Smoke#003.src: Are you familiar with any green tea dealers?
Celebrations in Smoke#003.dst: Conhece algum vendedor de chá verde?

Celebrations in Smoke#005.src: These ashes of a medallion seem to indicate that Arris really was exiled. You'll need to confront them about it.
Celebrations in Smoke#005.dst: Estas cinzas de medalhão indicam que o exílio de Arris era verdade. Você terá que confrontar Arris sobre isso.

Celebrations in Smoke#006.src: This looks like what Cerisa was trying to hide when she snuck in. It's a box full of... soldier's gear?
Celebrations in Smoke#006.dst: Deve ser o que Cerisa tentou esconder ao se infiltrar. É uma caixa cheia de... equipamento de soldado?

Celebrations in Smoke#007.src: I never said I thought you did it.
Celebrations in Smoke#007.dst: Eu nunca disse que foi você.

Celebrations in Smoke#008.src: One of your clan members told me you were exiled.
Celebrations in Smoke#008.dst: Alguém do seu clã me falou do seu exílio.

Celebrations in Smoke#009.src: Do you know Arris? They say they're a member of your clan?
Celebrations in Smoke#009.dst: Você conhece Arris? Diz que é do seu clã?

Celebrations in Smoke#010.dst: Leia o quadro de avisos em [-{~}, {~}, -{~}], perto de {p}.

Celebrations in Smoke#011.src: The board is plastered full of old notices, but a newer one catches your eye:
Celebrations in Smoke#011.dst: O quadro está cheio de avisos velhos, mas um mais novo chama sua atenção:
Celebrations in Smoke#011.speaker: Bulletin Board

Celebrations in Smoke#012.src: THE FESTIVAL OF THE WICKER HAS RETURNED AGAIN! JOIN THE ENTIRE MISTWOODS IN ALDWELL FOR THE FESTIVITIES
Celebrations in Smoke#012.dst: O FESTIVAL DO VIME ESTÁ DE VOLTA! JUNTE-SE A TODA MISTWOODS EM ALDWELL PARA AS FESTIVIDADES
Celebrations in Smoke#012.speaker: Bulletin Board

Celebrations in Smoke#013.src: It looks like the festival starts tomorrow afternoon. Would you like to attend?
Celebrations in Smoke#013.dst: Parece que o festival começa amanhã à tarde. Quer participar?
Celebrations in Smoke#013.speaker: Bulletin Board

Celebrations in Smoke#015.src: Enter the Festival of the Wicker at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Celebrations in Smoke#015.dst: Entre no Festival do Vime em [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Celebrations in Smoke#016.src: Welcome to the Festival of the Wicker!
Celebrations in Smoke#016.speaker: Aldwell Guard

Celebrations in Smoke#018.src: Than you cannot be trusted. Leave.
Celebrations in Smoke#018.dst: Então não é de confiança. Saia.
Celebrations in Smoke#018.speaker: Aldwell Guard

Celebrations in Smoke#019.src: Thank you, enjoy the festival! You can grab a mask inside.
Celebrations in Smoke#019.dst: Obrigado! Aproveite o festival! Há máscaras lá dentro.
Celebrations in Smoke#019.speaker: Aldwell Guard

Celebrations in Smoke#020.src: The board doesn't have anything else on it that catches your eye.
Celebrations in Smoke#020.dst: Não há mais nada no quadro que chame sua atenção.
Celebrations in Smoke#020.speaker: Bulletin Board

Celebrations in Smoke#021.src: We can't let you in without seeing your medallion!
Celebrations in Smoke#021.dst: Não dá para entrar sem mostrar o medalhão!
Celebrations in Smoke#021.speaker: Aldwell Guard

Celebrations in Smoke#023.src: Once you get inside, make sure to put your mask on.
Celebrations in Smoke#023.dst: Quando entrar, não esqueça de pôr a máscara.
Celebrations in Smoke#023.speaker: Aldwell Guard

Celebrations in Smoke#024.dst: Fale com os participantes do festival.

Celebrations in Smoke#025.src: I hope you're enjoying the festival!
Celebrations in Smoke#025.speaker: Aldwell Guard

Celebrations in Smoke#026.src: Welcome to Festival of the Wicker's premier food stall!
Celebrations in Smoke#026.dst: Bem-vindo à melhor barraca do Festival do Vime!
Celebrations in Smoke#026.speaker: Stall Attendant

Celebrations in Smoke#032.src: 'A clan member you hate will soon change your life.'
Celebrations in Smoke#032.dst: 'Um membro odiado do seu clã logo mudará sua vida.'
Celebrations in Smoke#032.speaker: Fortune Cookie

Celebrations in Smoke#034.src: 'A new love will soon enter your life!'
Celebrations in Smoke#034.speaker: Fortune Cookie

Celebrations in Smoke#035.src: 'Do not forget the danger of outsiders or someday you will have great trouble.'
Celebrations in Smoke#035.dst: 'Não esqueça o perigo dos forasteiros, ou um dia terá grandes problemas.'
Celebrations in Smoke#035.speaker: Fortune Cookie

Celebrations in Smoke#036.src: 'Avoid the forest floor, a great calamity awaits you.'
Celebrations in Smoke#036.dst: 'Evite o chão da floresta: uma calamidade te espera.'
Celebrations in Smoke#036.speaker: Fortune Cookie

Celebrations in Smoke#037.src: 'Love with the same passion that you hate or both will consume you.'
Celebrations in Smoke#037.dst: 'Ame com a mesma paixão com que odeia, ou ambos consumirão você.'
Celebrations in Smoke#037.speaker: Fortune Cookie

Celebrations in Smoke#038.src: 'Your suspicion which no one else believes will someday be right.'
Celebrations in Smoke#038.dst: 'A suspeita em que ninguém mais acredita um dia se provará certa.'
Celebrations in Smoke#038.speaker: Fortune Cookie

Celebrations in Smoke#040.src: 'Beware some of those closest to you! They may not be what they seem.'
Celebrations in Smoke#040.dst: 'Cuidado com alguns dos mais próximos! Podem não ser o que parecem.'
Celebrations in Smoke#040.speaker: Fortune Cookie

Celebrations in Smoke#041.src: 'Mist is pretty from a distance, but do not lose yourself in it.'
Celebrations in Smoke#041.dst: 'A névoa é bela de longe, mas não se perca nela.'
Celebrations in Smoke#041.speaker: Fortune Cookie

Celebrations in Smoke#042.src: 'Restrain your curiosity, especially around odd beatles.'
Celebrations in Smoke#042.dst: 'Contenha a curiosidade perto de besouros estranhos.'
Celebrations in Smoke#042.speaker: Fortune Cookie

Celebrations in Smoke#043.src: 'You will live an uneventful life, unremarkable in every way.'
Celebrations in Smoke#043.dst: 'Você terá uma vida pacata, sem nada de notável.'
Celebrations in Smoke#043.speaker: Fortune Cookie

Celebrations in Smoke#044.src: 'A river will both give and take what you love most.'
Celebrations in Smoke#044.dst: 'Um rio lhe dará e tirará o que você mais ama.'
Celebrations in Smoke#044.speaker: Fortune Cookie

Celebrations in Smoke#045.src: 'Make the most of your life, it will come to a nasty end.'
Celebrations in Smoke#045.dst: 'Aproveite bem a vida: ela terá um fim horrível.'
Celebrations in Smoke#045.speaker: Fortune Cookie

Celebrations in Smoke#046.src: 'Beware an uncomfortable encounter with an eagle.'
Celebrations in Smoke#046.dst: 'Cuidado com um encontro incômodo com uma águia.'
Celebrations in Smoke#046.speaker: Fortune Cookie

Celebrations in Smoke#047.src: I'm sorry, I'm still setting up, maybe I'll have something at a later date.
Celebrations in Smoke#047.dst: Desculpe, ainda estou montando a barraca; talvez tenha algo mais tarde.
Celebrations in Smoke#047.speaker: Stall Attendant

Celebrations in Smoke#049.src: What would you like to buy?
Celebrations in Smoke#049.speaker: Stall Attendant

Celebrations in Smoke#050.src: How many would you like to buy?
Celebrations in Smoke#050.speaker: Stall Attendant

Celebrations in Smoke#051.src: There is your token, enjoy the festival!
Celebrations in Smoke#051.speaker: Stall Attendant

Celebrations in Smoke#052.src: There are your tokens, enjoy the festival!
Celebrations in Smoke#052.speaker: Stall Attendant

Celebrations in Smoke#053.src: You can come get some at any time during the festival.
Celebrations in Smoke#053.dst: Pode vir buscar quando quiser durante o festival.
Celebrations in Smoke#053.speaker: Stall Attendant

Celebrations in Smoke#054.src: Make sure you do before the festival ends!
Celebrations in Smoke#054.dst: Só não deixe para depois do festival!
Celebrations in Smoke#054.speaker: Stall Attendant

Celebrations in Smoke#055.src: I'm afraid you can't afford that.
Celebrations in Smoke#055.dst: Acho que você não tem como pagar.
Celebrations in Smoke#055.speaker: Stall Attendant

Celebrations in Smoke#056.src: H-hi. I, um, hope you're having as good a time as I am.
Celebrations in Smoke#056.dst: O-oi. Eu, hã, espero que esteja curtindo como eu.
Celebrations in Smoke#056.speaker: Festival Attendee

Celebrations in Smoke#058.src: It really is fun to finally get a chance to relax.
Celebrations in Smoke#058.dst: É muito bom finalmente ter a chance de relaxar.
Celebrations in Smoke#058.speaker: Festival Attendee

Celebrations in Smoke#059.src: I love being a part of the Kalkalrah clan, but at times like this it's nice to have the chance to be alone.
Celebrations in Smoke#059.dst: Adoro fazer parte do clã Kalkalrah, mas em horas assim é bom poder ficar a sós.
Celebrations in Smoke#059.speaker: Festival Attendee

Celebrations in Smoke#060.src: Staring across the pond, enjoying the festival, surrounded by people I love.
Celebrations in Smoke#060.dst: Olhar o lago, curtir o festival, entre pessoas que amo.
Celebrations in Smoke#060.speaker: Festival Attendee

Celebrations in Smoke#061.src: It's a sort of quiet, safe calm. One unlike the rest of the year.
Celebrations in Smoke#061.dst: É uma calma tranquila e segura. Diferente do resto do ano.
Celebrations in Smoke#061.speaker: Festival Attendee

Celebrations in Smoke#062.src: It's the festival again! And you know what that means...
Celebrations in Smoke#062.dst: É festival de novo! E você sabe o que isso quer dizer...
Celebrations in Smoke#062.speaker: Festival Attendee

Celebrations in Smoke#063.src: Green tea!!! I never know how to get this stuff outside the festival.
Celebrations in Smoke#063.dst: Chá verde!!! Fora do festival nunca sei onde arranjar isso.
Celebrations in Smoke#063.speaker: Festival Attendee

Celebrations in Smoke#064.src: I'm going to spend all night standing right here, drinking as much of it as I can!
Celebrations in Smoke#064.dst: Vou passar a noite inteira bem aqui, bebendo o máximo que eu conseguir!
Celebrations in Smoke#064.speaker: Festival Attendee

Celebrations in Smoke#065.src: Do you want to watch the next round of fox races?
Celebrations in Smoke#065.dst: Quer ver a próxima rodada de corridas de raposa?
Celebrations in Smoke#065.speaker: Stall Attendant

Celebrations in Smoke#066.src: Get ready then, because they're ready to go!
Celebrations in Smoke#066.dst: Então se prepare, que elas já vão largar!
Celebrations in Smoke#066.speaker: Stall Attendant

Celebrations in Smoke#067.src: The rules are simple: you pick the fox you think will win a race around the wickerman and back.
Celebrations in Smoke#067.dst: As regras são simples: escolha a raposa que acha que vence a corrida em volta do homem de vime.
Celebrations in Smoke#067.speaker: Stall Attendant

Celebrations in Smoke#068.src: Costs {~} tokens to enter, you get your tokens back if your pick is {~}nd, double it if it gets first.
Celebrations in Smoke#068.dst: Entrar custa {~} fichas: se sua raposa chegar em {~}º, você as recupera; se vencer, ganha o dobro.
Celebrations in Smoke#068.speaker: Stall Attendant

Celebrations in Smoke#069.src: I'll give you a banner you can use to cheer your fox on. It should be helpful, although sometimes they can get a bit overwhelmed.
Celebrations in Smoke#069.dst: Vou te dar uma bandeirinha para torcer pela sua raposa. Costuma ajudar, mas às vezes elas ficam um pouco agitadas.
Celebrations in Smoke#069.speaker: Stall Attendant

Celebrations in Smoke#070.src: Best of luck if you do choose to play!
Celebrations in Smoke#070.speaker: Stall Attendant

Celebrations in Smoke#071.src: We'll be holding more races all night if you change your mind!
Celebrations in Smoke#071.dst: Vai ter mais corridas a noite toda, se mudar de ideia!
Celebrations in Smoke#071.speaker: Stall Attendant

Celebrations in Smoke#072.src: I'm afraid you don't have enough tokens to watch a fox race.
Celebrations in Smoke#072.dst: Receio que você não tenha fichas suficientes para a corrida.
Celebrations in Smoke#072.speaker: Stall Attendant

Celebrations in Smoke#073.src: If you need more, you can buy some at the Reward Merchant to the east.
Celebrations in Smoke#073.dst: Se precisar de mais, compre com o Mercador de recompensas a leste.
Celebrations in Smoke#073.speaker: Stall Attendant

Celebrations in Smoke#075.src: Wow! Your support for your fox was really impressive.
Celebrations in Smoke#075.dst: Uau! Sua torcida pela raposa foi impressionante.
Celebrations in Smoke#075.speaker: Stall Attendant

Celebrations in Smoke#076.src: You've easily earned these tokens. Enjoy!
Celebrations in Smoke#076.speaker: Stall Attendant

Celebrations in Smoke#077.src: Looks like you helped your fox want to win!
Celebrations in Smoke#077.dst: Você deu à sua raposa vontade de vencer!
Celebrations in Smoke#077.speaker: Stall Attendant

Celebrations in Smoke#078.src: It just wasn't strong enough to come in first.
Celebrations in Smoke#078.dst: Só não teve força para chegar em primeiro.
Celebrations in Smoke#078.speaker: Stall Attendant

Celebrations in Smoke#079.src: Second's not bad though! You've earned these tokens back.
Celebrations in Smoke#079.dst: Mas segundo lugar não é ruim! Suas fichas estão de volta.
Celebrations in Smoke#079.speaker: Stall Attendant

Celebrations in Smoke#080.src: Aww, it looks like your fox didn't manage to pull off a win.
Celebrations in Smoke#080.dst: Ah, parece que sua raposa não conseguiu vencer.
Celebrations in Smoke#080.speaker: Stall Attendant

Celebrations in Smoke#081.src: Maybe one of you needs to put in a bit more effort next time?
Celebrations in Smoke#081.dst: Talvez um de vocês precise se esforçar mais da próxima vez?
Celebrations in Smoke#081.speaker: Stall Attendant

Celebrations in Smoke#082.src: Hmm, in the last race, blue looked like it was going to...
Celebrations in Smoke#082.dst: Hum, na última corrida, a azul parecia que ia...
Celebrations in Smoke#082.speaker: Festival Attendee

Celebrations in Smoke#083.src: Oh, hi. Don't worry about me, I'm just analyzing the performances of the last few races.
Celebrations in Smoke#083.dst: Ah, oi. Não ligue para mim, só estou analisando o desempenho das últimas corridas.
Celebrations in Smoke#083.speaker: Festival Attendee

Celebrations in Smoke#084.src: It's nothing you'd be able to understand anyway, so don't worry about it.
Celebrations in Smoke#084.dst: Você não entenderia mesmo, então nem se preocupe.
Celebrations in Smoke#084.speaker: Festival Attendee

Celebrations in Smoke#085.src: Isn't it nice to see kids having fun?
Celebrations in Smoke#085.dst: Não é lindo ver crianças brincando?
Celebrations in Smoke#085.speaker: Festival Attendee

Celebrations in Smoke#086.src: I try to lighten his life when I can, but it's so hard to some days.
Celebrations in Smoke#086.dst: Tento alegrar a vida dele sempre que posso, mas tem dias duros.
Celebrations in Smoke#086.speaker: Festival Attendee

Celebrations in Smoke#087.src: That's why I love the festival. Makes my job easier!
Celebrations in Smoke#087.dst: Por isso adoro o festival. Facilita meu trabalho!
Celebrations in Smoke#087.speaker: Festival Attendee

Celebrations in Smoke#088.src: He can entertain himself, I can watch for danger.
Celebrations in Smoke#088.dst: Ele brinca sozinho e eu fico de olho em perigos.
Celebrations in Smoke#088.speaker: Festival Attendee

Celebrations in Smoke#089.src: I love when the festival finally comes around again!
Celebrations in Smoke#089.dst: Adoro quando o festival finalmente volta!
Celebrations in Smoke#089.speaker: Excited Child

Celebrations in Smoke#090.src: The festival is a great time to hang out with friends, away from anyone who might want to intrude on us.
Celebrations in Smoke#090.dst: O festival é ótimo para curtir com os amigos, longe de quem queira se intrometer.
Celebrations in Smoke#090.speaker: Clan Member

Celebrations in Smoke#091.src: Oh, it's so kind of you to come and see me.
Celebrations in Smoke#091.dst: Ah, que gentileza sua vir me ver.
Celebrations in Smoke#091.speaker: Elderly Woman

Celebrations in Smoke#092.src: I'm much too weak to ride the ziplines around town much anymore so I appreciate any company I can get.
Celebrations in Smoke#092.dst: Já não tenho forças para andar nas tirolesas da cidade, então agradeço qualquer companhia.
Celebrations in Smoke#092.speaker: Elderly Woman

Celebrations in Smoke#093.src: Even so, I love getting to sit on my porch and look down at all the happy people around this time of year.
Celebrations in Smoke#093.dst: Mesmo assim, adoro sentar na varanda e olhar lá embaixo todas as pessoas felizes nesta época do ano.
Celebrations in Smoke#093.speaker: Elderly Woman

Celebrations in Smoke#095.src: It's a lot of work to put on, but it's always worth it to see everyone together.
Celebrations in Smoke#095.dst: Dá muito trabalho organizar, mas sempre vale a pena ver todo mundo junto.
Celebrations in Smoke#095.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#096.src: This is the only time of year a lot of us get to relax, we have to take what we can get.
Celebrations in Smoke#096.dst: É a única época do ano em que muitos de nós podem relaxar; temos que aproveitar.
Celebrations in Smoke#096.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#097.src: Hm... do you hear that? That crackling... and that smell... is that...?
Celebrations in Smoke#097.dst: Hum... está ouvindo isso? Esse estalar... e esse cheiro... será...?
Celebrations in Smoke#097.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#099.src: Quick! Somebody run to the pond to get some water and put out the fire!
Celebrations in Smoke#099.dst: Rápido! Alguém corra até o lago, pegue água e apague o fogo!
Celebrations in Smoke#099.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#102.src: Thank you so much for your quick action. I hope you don't mind, but I'll need some more help.
Celebrations in Smoke#102.dst: Muito obrigado pela ação rápida. Espero que não se importe, mas vou precisar de mais ajuda.
Celebrations in Smoke#102.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#104.src: Can any of you show me a medallion?
Celebrations in Smoke#104.dst: Algum de vocês tem um medalhão?
Celebrations in Smoke#104.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#105.src: Just as I thought. All of you will be held until we can figure out the truth.
Celebrations in Smoke#105.dst: Como eu pensava. Vocês ficarão detidos até descobrirmos a verdade.
Celebrations in Smoke#105.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#106.src: Into that house, all three of you.
Celebrations in Smoke#106.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#107.src: There will have to be an investigation into this incident and you're one person I'm positive didn't start the fire.
Celebrations in Smoke#107.dst: Vamos ter que investigar este incidente, e você é a única pessoa que com certeza não começou o fogo.
Celebrations in Smoke#107.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#109.src: Follow the Festival Organizer into the house at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Celebrations in Smoke#109.dst: Siga o organizador do festival até a casa em [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Celebrations in Smoke#110.src: Thank you so much for your help again, without your assistance the festival would have been ruined.
Celebrations in Smoke#110.dst: Muito obrigado de novo pela ajuda; sem você, o festival teria sido arruinado.
Celebrations in Smoke#110.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#111.src: I cannot express my gratitude more effusely, but I'm afraid I must ask more of you.
Celebrations in Smoke#111.dst: Mal consigo expressar minha gratidão, mas receio ter que te pedir mais uma coisa.
Celebrations in Smoke#111.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#112.src: You see, I do not believe that fire was set by an accident. There's a vandal in our midst and I fear the worst.
Celebrations in Smoke#112.dst: Veja, não acredito que esse fogo tenha sido um acidente. Há um vândalo entre nós, e temo o pior.
Celebrations in Smoke#112.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#113.src: Just as generations ago, when our ancestors first exposed and immolated the changeling threat that we are supposed to be celebrating today, we must remain vigilant!
Celebrations in Smoke#113.dst: Assim como há gerações, quando nossos ancestrais desmascararam e queimaram pela primeira vez a ameaça metamorfa que hoje celebramos, devemos continuar vigilantes!
Celebrations in Smoke#113.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#114.src: Unfortunately... the festival has always been a time when that vigilance has lapsed a bit. We have an unwelcome attendee.
Celebrations in Smoke#114.dst: Infelizmente... o festival sempre foi uma época em que essa vigilância relaxa um pouco. Temos um convidado indesejado.
Celebrations in Smoke#114.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#115.src: I suspect that flame was set by a changeling, hoping to use the fire as a distraction to infiltrate the festival. To catch someone off guard and take their form.
Celebrations in Smoke#115.dst: Suspeito que um metamorfo ateou o fogo, querendo usá-lo como distração para se infiltrar no festival. Para pegar alguém desprevenido e assumir sua forma.
Celebrations in Smoke#115.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#116.src: Due to your efforts, they were unable to do so. But they could not have gone far.
Celebrations in Smoke#116.dst: Graças a você, não conseguiu. Mas não pode ter ido longe.
Celebrations in Smoke#116.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#117.src: I rounded up the three people nearest to where the fire ignited and found all of them had snuck in without a medallion!
Celebrations in Smoke#117.dst: Reuni as três pessoas mais perto de onde o fogo começou, e todas tinham entrado escondidas sem medalhão!
Celebrations in Smoke#117.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#118.src: While I keep them held here... I'd ask of you to interrogate them and, if needed, search around the festival to find information on who they really are.
Celebrations in Smoke#118.dst: Enquanto os mantenho aqui... peço que você os interrogue e, se preciso, procure pelo festival informações sobre quem eles realmente são.
Celebrations in Smoke#118.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#119.src: Once you have unmasked each of them for who they really are, return to me and tell me which one is a changeling in disguise. I can handle matters from there.
Celebrations in Smoke#119.dst: Quando tiver desmascarado cada um deles, volte e me diga qual é o metamorfo disfarçado. Daí em diante, eu cuido do resto.
Celebrations in Smoke#119.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#120.src: Take this book. You can write any notes you take while investigating down to check later.
Celebrations in Smoke#120.dst: Pegue este livro. Anote nele o que descobrir na investigação para consultar depois.
Celebrations in Smoke#120.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#121.src: Once you've investigated all of them, you can return to me.
Celebrations in Smoke#121.dst: Depois de investigar os três, volte a falar comigo.
Celebrations in Smoke#121.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#122.src: Find evidence against the three suspects.
Celebrations in Smoke#122.dst: Encontre provas contra os três suspeitos.

Celebrations in Smoke#123.src: Come back to me once you've found what they're all hiding.
Celebrations in Smoke#123.dst: Volte quando descobrir o que todos eles escondem.
Celebrations in Smoke#123.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#126.src: I don't know how, but this alley must have slipped through our planning.
Celebrations in Smoke#126.dst: Não sei como, mas este beco deve ter escapado do nosso planejamento.
Celebrations in Smoke#126.speaker: Aldwell Guard

Celebrations in Smoke#127.src: I'll stand here for now to make sure no one can get in.
Celebrations in Smoke#127.dst: Vou ficar aqui por enquanto para ninguém entrar.
Celebrations in Smoke#127.speaker: Aldwell Guard

Celebrations in Smoke#128.src: I'm so grateful you warned us before anyone bad might have noticed it.
Celebrations in Smoke#128.dst: Ainda bem que você avisou antes que algum malfeitor percebesse.
Celebrations in Smoke#128.speaker: Aldwell Guard

Celebrations in Smoke#129.src: Thank you so much for exposing that gap in our security!
Celebrations in Smoke#129.dst: Muito obrigado por expor essa falha na nossa segurança!
Celebrations in Smoke#129.speaker: Aldwell Guard

Celebrations in Smoke#130.src: I'm, um, Arris. I don't know what's happening, I got shoved into here by the festival organizer with these other two.
Celebrations in Smoke#130.dst: Sou, hã, Arris. Não sei o que está acontecendo, o organizador do festival me enfiou aqui com esses outros dois.

Celebrations in Smoke#131.src: Why are you admitting that you're a thief?
Celebrations in Smoke#131.dst: Por que admite que é uma ladra?

Celebrations in Smoke#133.src: Some regions are circled, appearing to indicate the location of easy game.
Celebrations in Smoke#133.dst: Algumas áreas estão circuladas; parecem indicar onde há caça fácil.

Celebrations in Smoke#134.src: That should be enough to go off if you can find someone who was observant enough to see Cerisa sneak in. If you want to get more information though, you can continue the interrogation.
Celebrations in Smoke#134.dst: Isso deve bastar para seguir a pista se achar alguém atento o bastante para ter visto Cerisa entrar escondida. Mas, se quiser mais informações, pode continuar o interrogatório.

Celebrations in Smoke#135.src: New Quest Start: Celebrations in Smoke
Celebrations in Smoke#135.dst: Nova missão iniciada: Festa que virou fumaça

Celebrations in Smoke#136.src: From the information you have, he just looks like a hunter who really likes green tea?
Celebrations in Smoke#136.dst: Pelo que você sabe, ele não parece só um caçador que adora chá verde?

Celebrations in Smoke#137.src: It's still stuck. Maybe try again, pulling even harder?
Celebrations in Smoke#137.dst: Ainda está preso. Tente de novo puxando mais forte?

Celebrations in Smoke#138.src: You wouldn't know of anyone at all who claimed to be a green tea merchant?
Celebrations in Smoke#138.dst: Por acaso conhece alguém que se diga mercador de chá verde?

Celebrations in Smoke#139.src: Do you want to wear the fox mask?
Celebrations in Smoke#139.dst: Quer usar a máscara de raposa?

Celebrations in Smoke#140.src: Based on what you've seen here, while Burick does have a lot of green tea, there's no evidence he's a merchant.
Celebrations in Smoke#140.dst: Pelo que você viu aqui, Burick tem muito chá verde, mas nada prova que ele seja mercador.

Celebrations in Smoke#143.src: Ask the clan member further questions?
Celebrations in Smoke#143.dst: Perguntar mais ao membro do clã?

Celebrations in Smoke#144.src: What does it even mean to be a trader in the {p}?
Celebrations in Smoke#144.dst: O que significa ser comerciante em {p}, afinal?

Celebrations in Smoke#145.src: Did you see who burned down the wickerman?
Celebrations in Smoke#145.dst: Viu quem queimou o homem de vime?

Celebrations in Smoke#147.src: Ask the tea enthusiast further questions?
Celebrations in Smoke#147.dst: Perguntar mais ao fã de chá?

Celebrations in Smoke#148.src: Why did you burn down the wickerman?
Celebrations in Smoke#148.dst: Por que queimou o homem de vime?

Celebrations in Smoke#149.src: You'll have to interrogate him again to see if you can get any new information.
Celebrations in Smoke#149.dst: Você terá que interrogá-lo de novo para ver se consegue algo novo.

Celebrations in Smoke#150.src: I found your camp. There's green tea, but nothing else I would expect from a merchant
Celebrations in Smoke#150.dst: Achei seu acampamento. Tem chá verde, mas nada mais que eu esperaria de um mercador

Celebrations in Smoke#151.src: I'm simply an ordinary member of the Kalkalrah clan, I don't know what's happening.
Celebrations in Smoke#151.dst: Sou só um membro comum do clã Kalkalrah, não sei o que está acontecendo.
Celebrations in Smoke#151.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#152.src: Please don't accuse me of doing whatever you think I did, please.
Celebrations in Smoke#152.dst: Por favor, não me acuse do que você acha que eu fiz, por favor.
Celebrations in Smoke#152.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#154.src: Nothing, I don't think. Or, well, that's not what I meant.
Celebrations in Smoke#154.dst: Nada, acho. Ou, bem, não foi isso que eu quis dizer.
Celebrations in Smoke#154.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#155.src: I only, um, do general upkeep. Fixing stuff and cleaning stuff, I mean.
Celebrations in Smoke#155.dst: Eu só, hã, faço manutenção geral. Consertar e limpar coisas, digo.
Celebrations in Smoke#155.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#156.src: There's not much more to say than that, you know?
Celebrations in Smoke#156.dst: Não há muito mais a dizer, sabe?
Celebrations in Smoke#156.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#157.src: I'm nothing more than a helpful member of my clan who assists in the, uh- in the "making everyone live together with ease" part of clan life!
Celebrations in Smoke#157.dst: Sou só um membro prestativo do meu clã que ajuda na, hã- na parte de "fazer todo mundo conviver em paz" da vida no clã!
Celebrations in Smoke#157.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#158.src: That's what I mean by nothing, you see, that's what I meant when I said that.
Celebrations in Smoke#158.dst: É isso que eu quis dizer com nada, entende, foi isso que eu quis dizer.
Celebrations in Smoke#158.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#159.src: I don't literally do nothing, obviously, that would be dumb. I have an important role and am, uh, valued by my clan.
Celebrations in Smoke#159.dst: Não que eu não faça nada literalmente, claro, seria bobo. Tenho um papel importante e, hã, meu clã me valoriza.
Celebrations in Smoke#159.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#160.src: But it isn't super important or cool or anything, that's what I meant by nothing.
Celebrations in Smoke#160.dst: Mas não é nada superimportante nem legal, era isso que eu quis dizer com nada.
Celebrations in Smoke#160.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#161.src: Oh, that's what you meant. You, um, wanted a specific answer.
Celebrations in Smoke#161.dst: Ah, era isso. Você, hã, queria uma resposta específica.
Celebrations in Smoke#161.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#162.src: Okay. I can give you that.
Celebrations in Smoke#162.dst: Tá. Isso eu posso te dar.
Celebrations in Smoke#162.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#163.src: Like sometimes I will guard things. I will, um, um, stand watch for changelings or thieves or animals!
Celebrations in Smoke#163.dst: Tipo, às vezes eu vigio coisas. Eu, hã, hã, fico de guarda contra metamorfos, ladrões ou animais!
Celebrations in Smoke#163.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#164.src: Or anything trying to steal. We try to stop people from stealing from us.
Celebrations in Smoke#164.dst: Ou qualquer coisa que tente roubar. Tentamos impedir que nos roubem.
Celebrations in Smoke#164.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#166.src: Oh, sorry, I'm not trying to be.
Celebrations in Smoke#166.dst: Ah, desculpe, não é por querer.
Celebrations in Smoke#166.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#167.src: I'm not, um, sure what's happening. And that makes me a little nervous, can you understand?
Celebrations in Smoke#167.dst: Não sei, hã, direito o que está acontecendo. E isso me dá um pouco de nervoso, entende?
Celebrations in Smoke#167.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#168.src: All this investigation stuff makes me feel like I did something wrong. And I didn't do anything wrong!
Celebrations in Smoke#168.dst: Toda essa investigação me faz sentir que fiz algo errado. E eu não fiz nada de errado!
Celebrations in Smoke#168.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#169.src: But it's hard to prove that and so I get nervous and stumble over the things I'm saying and misstate what I really mean which only makes it harder!
Celebrations in Smoke#169.dst: Mas é difícil provar isso, aí bate o nervoso e eu tropeço nas palavras e digo errado o que quero dizer, e isso só piora tudo!
Celebrations in Smoke#169.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#170.src: Sorry. I don't think I'm helping my case.
Celebrations in Smoke#170.dst: Desculpe. Acho que não estou me ajudando.
Celebrations in Smoke#170.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#172.src: I think a little bit? But obviously not as much as this! Like when I'm under interrogation for something I didn't do even though you really seem to think I did.
Celebrations in Smoke#172.dst: Um pouco, acho? Mas claro que não tanto quanto agora! Tipo quando me interrogam por algo que não fiz, mesmo você parecendo ter certeza de que fiz.
Celebrations in Smoke#172.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#173.src: Well, um, of course you do. You're going to think I committed arson or something and then report me and everything will be horrible.
Celebrations in Smoke#173.dst: Bem, hã, claro que acha. Vai achar que eu causei um incêndio ou algo assim, aí vai me denunciar e tudo vai ser horrível.
Celebrations in Smoke#173.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#174.src: There's no way you don't think I didn't. Look at how much time you're spending interrogating me compared to everyone else.
Celebrations in Smoke#174.dst: Não tem como você não achar que fui eu. Olha quanto tempo você passa me interrogando comparado com os outros.
Celebrations in Smoke#174.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#175.src: Please. Please don't. I didn't do it I promise I didn't do it, please don't think that I did it.
Celebrations in Smoke#175.dst: Por favor. Por favor, não. Não fui eu, prometo que não fui eu, por favor não pense que fui eu.
Celebrations in Smoke#175.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#176.src: I'm innocent I promise please, I didn't do anything I didn't I swear.
Celebrations in Smoke#176.dst: Sou inocente eu prometo por favor, não fiz nada não fiz eu juro.
Celebrations in Smoke#176.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#183.src: Sorry I don't think I'm, uh, cut out for that, sorry.
Celebrations in Smoke#183.dst: Desculpe, acho que não, hã, nasci pra isso, desculpe.
Celebrations in Smoke#183.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#185.src: No, I don't think- I didn't see.
Celebrations in Smoke#185.dst: Não, acho que não- Eu não vi.
Celebrations in Smoke#185.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#186.src: Maybe I saw some movement out of the corner of my eye? But that could have been nothing.
Celebrations in Smoke#186.dst: Talvez eu tenha visto algo se mexer com o canto do olho? Mas podia não ser nada.
Celebrations in Smoke#186.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#187.src: It's hard to know, I wasn't really paying attention at the time and now you're asking me these questions like I have some sort of, um, picture perfect memory!
Celebrations in Smoke#187.dst: É difícil saber, eu não estava prestando atenção na hora e agora você me faz essas perguntas como se eu tivesse uma, hã, memória fotográfica perfeita!
Celebrations in Smoke#187.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#188.src: Even though I definitely don't! And wasn't even trying to remember what was happening in the first place!
Celebrations in Smoke#188.dst: Que eu não tenho mesmo! E nem estava tentando lembrar o que acontecia, para começo de conversa!
Celebrations in Smoke#188.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#189.src: Sorry, I was shouting, wasn't I. I didn't mean to. I'm only stressed. Sorry.
Celebrations in Smoke#189.dst: Desculpe, eu gritei, né? Não foi por querer. É só o estresse. Desculpe.
Celebrations in Smoke#189.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#190.src: I didn't! I promise I didn't.
Celebrations in Smoke#190.dst: Não fui eu! Eu juro que não.
Celebrations in Smoke#190.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#191.src: Please don't think I tried to, I promise I have no idea what you're talking about.
Celebrations in Smoke#191.dst: Por favor, não pense que eu tentei, juro que não sei do que você está falando.
Celebrations in Smoke#191.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#192.src: All that I was doing was sitting there quietly and then all of a sudden behind me there were really big flames and then before I could even act you threw water on them and saved the wickerman and then I was being brought in here even though I
Celebrations in Smoke#192.dst: Eu só estava ali sem incomodar ninguém e de repente atrás de mim tinha umas chamas enormes e antes que eu pudesse reagir você jogou água nelas e salvou o homem de vime e aí me trouxeram pra cá mesmo eu
Celebrations in Smoke#192.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#193.src: didn't do anything and am just an ordinary clan member and have nothing to hide.
Celebrations in Smoke#193.dst: não tendo feito nada e sendo só um membro comum do clã sem nada a esconder.
Celebrations in Smoke#193.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#194.src: I promise I didn't try to burn down the wickerman.
Celebrations in Smoke#194.dst: Juro que não tentei queimar o homem de vime.
Celebrations in Smoke#194.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#195.src: Find someone who might know something about Arris's clan.
Celebrations in Smoke#195.dst: Encontre alguém que possa saber algo sobre o clã de Arris.

Celebrations in Smoke#196.src: Hmm? Ah. Yes, unfortunately I do.
Celebrations in Smoke#196.speaker: Festival Attendee

Celebrations in Smoke#197.src: They were a member of our clan until a week ago, when they were expelled and exiled.
Celebrations in Smoke#197.dst: Arris era do nosso clã até uma semana atrás, quando veio a expulsão e o exílio.
Celebrations in Smoke#197.speaker: Festival Attendee

Celebrations in Smoke#198.src: Their old medallion was handed to me to burn. In fact, just on my way into the festival I threw its ashes up the tallest tree in {p}.
Celebrations in Smoke#198.dst: Me deram o antigo medalhão de Arris para queimar. Aliás, a caminho do festival, joguei as cinzas na árvore mais alta de {p}.
Celebrations in Smoke#198.speaker: Festival Attendee

Celebrations in Smoke#199.src: Interrogated them? Oh, I hope they haven't done anything bad.
Celebrations in Smoke#199.dst: Interrogou Arris? Ai, espero que não tenha feito nada errado.
Celebrations in Smoke#199.speaker: Festival Attendee

Celebrations in Smoke#200.src: You know, they were always a bit troubled. But I don't think they're bad. They just weren't suited for clan life.
Celebrations in Smoke#200.dst: Sabe, Arris sempre teve seus problemas. Mas não acho que seja má pessoa. Só não combinava com a vida de clã.
Celebrations in Smoke#200.speaker: Festival Attendee

Celebrations in Smoke#202.src: The fate they were given will be a hard one though. Most exiles don't survive a year.
Celebrations in Smoke#202.dst: Mas o destino que lhe coube vai ser duro. A maioria dos exilados não dura um ano.
Celebrations in Smoke#202.speaker: Festival Attendee

Celebrations in Smoke#203.src: Not as much as I wish you could. Please treat them with kindness though, they only lie out of fear.
Celebrations in Smoke#203.dst: Não tanto quanto eu queria. Mas, por favor, trate Arris com bondade: só mente por medo.
Celebrations in Smoke#203.speaker: Festival Attendee

Celebrations in Smoke#204.src: I do not mean to be rude, but you cut an imposing figure. There's a lot to be afraid of.
Celebrations in Smoke#204.dst: Sem querer ofender, mas você impõe respeito. Há muito o que temer.
Celebrations in Smoke#204.speaker: Festival Attendee

Celebrations in Smoke#205.src: I hope they stays well, even if they are troubled.
Celebrations in Smoke#205.dst: Espero que Arris fique bem, apesar de tudo.
Celebrations in Smoke#205.speaker: Festival Attendee

Celebrations in Smoke#206.src: No no no, that isn't true at all.
Celebrations in Smoke#206.dst: Não não não, isso não é verdade.
Celebrations in Smoke#206.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#207.src: I have no idea who or what you were talking to but I can assure you I, uh, was not exiled from my clan very recently.
Celebrations in Smoke#207.dst: Não faço ideia de com quem ou com o quê você falou, mas garanto que, hã, ninguém me exilou do meu clã há pouco tempo.
Celebrations in Smoke#207.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#208.src: You don't have any proof of it, right? Right? So it's my word against theirs, there is no reason to believe anything that they have to say over me.
Celebrations in Smoke#208.dst: Você não tem nenhuma prova, né? Né? Então é minha palavra contra a de quem disse isso, não há motivo pra acreditar mais nessa pessoa do que em mim.
Celebrations in Smoke#208.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#209.src: I'm an, um, ordinary clan member who got caught up in something that I do not understand.
Celebrations in Smoke#209.dst: Sou, hã, um membro comum do clã envolvido em algo que não entende.
Celebrations in Smoke#209.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#210.src: Search the tallest tree in {p} for Arris's burnt medallion.
Celebrations in Smoke#210.dst: Procure o medalhão queimado de Arris na árvore mais alta de {p}.

Celebrations in Smoke#213.src: Yes I was exiled from my clan and yes I did lie to you but I promise I didn't do anything else bad.
Celebrations in Smoke#213.dst: Sim, me exilaram do meu clã e sim, eu menti pra você, mas juro que não fiz mais nada de errado.
Celebrations in Smoke#213.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#214.src: I don't know who burned down the wickerman but it wasn't me, you have to believe me.
Celebrations in Smoke#214.dst: Não sei quem queimou o homem de vime, mas não fui eu, você tem que acreditar em mim.
Celebrations in Smoke#214.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#215.src: I only lied because I panicked and I'm sorry for panicking but please please please you cannot tell them that I'm a changeling or whatever.
Celebrations in Smoke#215.dst: Só menti porque entrei em pânico, desculpa, mas por favor por favor por favor não diga a eles que sou um metamorfo ou sei lá o quê.
Celebrations in Smoke#215.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#217.src: Because they all thought I stole something! Even though I promise, I promise I didn't.
Celebrations in Smoke#217.dst: Porque todos acharam que eu roubei algo! Mesmo eu jurando, jurando que não.
Celebrations in Smoke#217.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#218.src: I was supposed to be keeping watch over our clan's stores. And I don't know how, but a box of our special green tea went missing.
Celebrations in Smoke#218.dst: Eu devia estar vigiando o depósito do clã. E não sei como, mas sumiu uma caixa do nosso chá verde especial.
Celebrations in Smoke#218.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#219.src: I promise I didn't steal it, I really do. But none of them believed me, it somehow disappeared.
Celebrations in Smoke#219.dst: Juro que não roubei, juro mesmo. Mas ninguém acreditou em mim; simplesmente sumiu.
Celebrations in Smoke#219.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#220.src: They said I had lost years of trust with them, over something I swear I didn't do, and kicked me out.
Celebrations in Smoke#220.dst: Disseram que eu tinha perdido anos de confiança por algo que juro que não fiz, e me expulsaram.
Celebrations in Smoke#220.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#221.src: Since then, I've been having to find my own way to survive. I've, uh, not been very good at that.
Celebrations in Smoke#221.dst: Desde então, tenho que me virar por conta própria. E, hã, não tenho me saído muito bem.
Celebrations in Smoke#221.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#222.src: Maybe a week? I- I- I'm not exactly sure. It has been difficult keeping track of time.
Celebrations in Smoke#222.dst: Uma semana, talvez? N-n-não sei direito. Tem sido difícil contar o tempo.
Celebrations in Smoke#222.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#223.src: Yes! I've never lost anything like that before and I definitely haven't stolen anything ever at all.
Celebrations in Smoke#223.dst: Sim! Nunca tinha perdido nada assim antes, e com certeza nunca roubei nada na vida.
Celebrations in Smoke#223.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#224.src: ... Although, I was caught sleeping while on watch a few times. And my clan got really upset with me for that, even though I promise nothing bad happened.
Celebrations in Smoke#224.dst: ... Se bem que me pegaram dormindo na vigia algumas vezes. E meu clã ficou muito bravo comigo por isso, mesmo eu jurando que nada de ruim aconteceu.
Celebrations in Smoke#224.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#225.src: I wasn't trying to sleep, but it's so hard to stay up all night while nothing is happening.
Celebrations in Smoke#225.dst: Eu não queria dormir, mas é muito difícil passar a noite em claro sem nada acontecer.
Celebrations in Smoke#225.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#228.src: Oh, uh, well you know. I was, um.
Celebrations in Smoke#228.dst: Ah, hã, sabe como é. É que, hum.
Celebrations in Smoke#228.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#230.src: And this was the only place I could think of that would have any and I really missed not having to run across the {p} trying to forage and I really really hate being exiled and I need somewhere to go.
Celebrations in Smoke#230.dst: E este era o único lugar que me ocorreu onde teria comida, e eu sentia muita falta de não ter que cruzar {p} catando comida, e eu odeio muito, muito estar no exílio e preciso de um lugar para ir.
Celebrations in Smoke#230.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#231.src: Sorry, I didn't mean to dump all my troubles on you.
Celebrations in Smoke#231.dst: Desculpe, não queria jogar meus problemas em você.
Celebrations in Smoke#231.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#233.src: Um. If it wouldn't be too much to ask.
Celebrations in Smoke#233.dst: Hum. Se não for pedir demais.
Celebrations in Smoke#233.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#234.src: Would you mind getting me a Fortune Cookie?
Celebrations in Smoke#234.dst: Pode me trazer um biscoito da sorte?
Celebrations in Smoke#234.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#235.src: I don't want to burden you or anything and I know I just lied to you and you're trying to investigate me for a horrible crime, but I'm really hungry and didn't get a chance to eat before you all shoved me in here.
Celebrations in Smoke#235.dst: Não quero ser um fardo nem nada, e sei que acabei de mentir pra você e que você está me investigando por um crime horrível, mas estou com muita fome e não deu tempo de comer antes de me enfiarem aqui.
Celebrations in Smoke#235.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#236.src: Thank you so so so so much.
Celebrations in Smoke#236.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#237.src: Thank you! I don't think I've had one of these since I was a kid.
Celebrations in Smoke#237.dst: Valeu! Acho que não como um desses desde criança.
Celebrations in Smoke#237.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#238.src: Here, let me read my fortune to you.
Celebrations in Smoke#238.dst: Olha, vou ler minha sorte pra você.
Celebrations in Smoke#238.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#239.src: "Beware some of those closest to you! They may not be what they seem."
Celebrations in Smoke#239.dst: "Cuidado com alguns dos mais próximos! Podem não ser o que parecem."
Celebrations in Smoke#239.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#240.src: That, uh, would have been more useful a couple weeks ago.
Celebrations in Smoke#240.dst: Isso, hã, teria sido mais útil umas duas semanas atrás.
Celebrations in Smoke#240.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#242.src: Sorry. Please don't think I did whatever I can tell you think I did.
Celebrations in Smoke#242.dst: Desculpe. Não ache que fiz o que dá pra ver que você acha.
Celebrations in Smoke#242.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#243.src: Burick. I'm simply a humble green tea trader.
Celebrations in Smoke#243.dst: Burick. Um humilde comerciante de chá verde.

Celebrations in Smoke#244.src: I don't know what happened, I wasn't involved, and that's all I have to say.
Celebrations in Smoke#244.dst: Não sei o que houve, não tive envolvimento, e é tudo o que tenho a dizer.
Celebrations in Smoke#244.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#246.src: I found this burnt medallion, confirming what I was told by a former clan member of yours. You were exiled for theft.
Celebrations in Smoke#246.dst: Achei este medalhão queimado, que confirma o que um ex-companheiro do seu clã me disse. Você foi exilada por roubo.

Celebrations in Smoke#247.src: That should be enough to go off if you can find someone who buys a lot of green tea. If you want to get more information though, you can continue the interrogation.
Celebrations in Smoke#247.dst: Isso deve bastar para seguir a pista se você encontrar alguém que compre muito chá verde. Mas, se quiser mais informações, pode continuar o interrogatório.

similar.text: That should be enough to go off if you can find someone who was observant enough to see Cerisa sneak in. If you want to get more information though, you can continue the interrogation.

Celebrations in Smoke#248.src: One clan wants to get rid of stuff, while another clan wants to get their hands on it.
Celebrations in Smoke#248.dst: Um clã quer se livrar de algo, e outro clã quer pôr as mãos nisso.
Celebrations in Smoke#248.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#249.src: The {p} is a big and dangerous place. They need a trader to make it happen.
Celebrations in Smoke#249.dst: {p} é um lugar grande e perigoso. Precisam de um comerciante para isso.
Celebrations in Smoke#249.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#250.src: Yes. Someone has to do it though.
Celebrations in Smoke#250.dst: Sim. Mas alguém tem que fazer.
Celebrations in Smoke#250.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#251.src: Nope. And neither has anyone else I've spoken to.
Celebrations in Smoke#251.dst: Não. Nem ninguém com quem eu falei.
Celebrations in Smoke#251.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#252.src: I'm not even certain they're real.
Celebrations in Smoke#252.dst: Nem sei se eles existem mesmo.
Celebrations in Smoke#252.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#253.src: Don't mention to anyone else that I said that.
Celebrations in Smoke#253.dst: Não conte a ninguém que eu disse isso.
Celebrations in Smoke#253.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#254.src: Some people get really upset when you imply that.
Celebrations in Smoke#254.dst: Tem gente que se irrita muito com essa ideia.
Celebrations in Smoke#254.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#255.src: The Kalkalrah clan sells it to me. So wherever they get it, I suppose.
Celebrations in Smoke#255.dst: O clã Kalkalrah me vende. Então de onde eles tiram, imagino.
Celebrations in Smoke#255.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#256.src: Yes. That's what a merchant is.
Celebrations in Smoke#256.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#257.src: I'm not a member of any clan. I travel around selling my products.
Celebrations in Smoke#257.dst: Não sou de clã nenhum. Viajo por aí vendendo meus produtos.
Celebrations in Smoke#257.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#258.src: Clan life would be too stifling. I like getting to see more than the trunk of a single tree.
Celebrations in Smoke#258.dst: A vida de clã seria sufocante demais. Gosto de ver mais do que o tronco de uma única árvore.
Celebrations in Smoke#258.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#261.src: I'm a merchant, not a member of a clan.
Celebrations in Smoke#261.dst: Sou mercador, não membro de clã.
Celebrations in Smoke#261.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#262.src: I don't have a way to get one and it hasn't been a problem.
Celebrations in Smoke#262.dst: Não tenho como conseguir um e isso nunca foi problema.
Celebrations in Smoke#262.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#263.src: I walked closely behind a group that did.
Celebrations in Smoke#263.dst: Entrei colado num grupo que tinha.
Celebrations in Smoke#263.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#265.src: Gives me a good chance to investigate the green tea market too.
Celebrations in Smoke#265.dst: Também é uma boa chance de estudar o mercado de chá verde.
Celebrations in Smoke#265.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#267.src: Trades were handled quickly, while the other parties were heavily armed, and in small enough quantities that if I was a changeling no major loss would be incurred.
Celebrations in Smoke#267.dst: As trocas eram rápidas, a outra parte andava bem armada, e as quantidades eram pequenas o bastante para que, se eu fosse um metamorfo, a perda não fosse grande.
Celebrations in Smoke#267.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#269.src: I did not and I would not hazard a guess as to who did.
Celebrations in Smoke#269.dst: Não vi, e não arriscaria um palpite sobre quem foi.
Celebrations in Smoke#269.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#270.src: I am answering your questions to the best of my knowledge and ability.
Celebrations in Smoke#270.dst: Estou respondendo às suas perguntas da melhor forma que sei e posso.
Celebrations in Smoke#270.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#271.src: Isn't it your job to figure that stuff out?
Celebrations in Smoke#271.dst: Descobrir isso não é trabalho seu?
Celebrations in Smoke#271.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#272.src: I see no reason to do your own work and give you more rope to hang me with.
Celebrations in Smoke#272.dst: Não vejo por que fazer seu trabalho e te dar mais corda para me enforcar.
Celebrations in Smoke#272.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#273.dst: É só um jeito de falar.
Celebrations in Smoke#273.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#274.src: I'm cooperating. But I don't see why I should trust someone I don't know or trust with more details than they need.
Celebrations in Smoke#274.dst: Estou cooperando. Mas não vejo por que dar a um estranho em quem não confio mais detalhes que o necessário.
Celebrations in Smoke#274.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#275.src: It would be helpful for my business if you just let me go.
Celebrations in Smoke#275.dst: Seria bom para os meus negócios se você me soltasse.
Celebrations in Smoke#275.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#276.src: But I'm not demanding that. You can give me the same etiquette.
Celebrations in Smoke#276.dst: Mas não estou exigindo isso. Você pode ter a mesma cortesia.
Celebrations in Smoke#276.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#278.src: Sure, but I have no use for your emeralds.
Celebrations in Smoke#278.dst: Claro, mas suas esmeraldas não me servem.
Celebrations in Smoke#278.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#279.src: It's been a while since I've had some rabbit roast. Get some of that for me and I'll see what I can do.
Celebrations in Smoke#279.dst: Faz tempo que não como coelho assado. Me traga um pouco que vou ver o que posso fazer.
Celebrations in Smoke#279.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#280.src: Huh. I didn't think you actually would, thanks.
Celebrations in Smoke#280.dst: Hum. Não achei que fosse trazer mesmo. Valeu.
Celebrations in Smoke#280.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#281.src: Anyway, I'm terse because I'm used to being. It doesn't really have anything to do with you.
Celebrations in Smoke#281.dst: Enfim, sou seco porque me acostumei. Não tem nada a ver com você.
Celebrations in Smoke#281.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#282.src: I spend so much time alone by myself in the woods that I'm not used to making conversation, even when it's needed.
Celebrations in Smoke#282.dst: Passo tanto tempo sozinho na floresta que não estou acostumado a conversar, nem quando é preciso.
Celebrations in Smoke#282.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#283.src: Sorry, you seem nice, I wish I could be of more use to your investigation.
Celebrations in Smoke#283.dst: Desculpe, você parece gente boa; queria ajudar mais na sua investigação.
Celebrations in Smoke#283.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#284.src: I have enough of them as is.
Celebrations in Smoke#284.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#285.src: Most of the time I trade in kind anyway.
Celebrations in Smoke#285.dst: Quase sempre faço escambo, de todo modo.
Celebrations in Smoke#285.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#288.src: I don't know and you're not getting a guess out of me.
Celebrations in Smoke#288.dst: Não sei, e você não vai arrancar um palpite de mim.
Celebrations in Smoke#288.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#289.src: I could have missed something, but I didn't see any of us do it.
Celebrations in Smoke#289.dst: Posso ter perdido algo, mas não vi nenhum de nós fazer isso.
Celebrations in Smoke#289.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#290.src: Find someone who might be familiar with a green tea merchant.
Celebrations in Smoke#290.dst: Encontre alguém que possa conhecer um mercador de chá verde.

Celebrations in Smoke#293.src: Please, tell me, I would love to know. I've been searching for one for years.
Celebrations in Smoke#293.dst: Por favor, me diga, eu adoraria saber. Procuro um há anos.
Celebrations in Smoke#293.speaker: Festival Attendee

Celebrations in Smoke#294.src: The closest I got was some odd tent in the woods east of {p} with a box of the stuff, but that just a scavenger's tent.
Celebrations in Smoke#294.dst: O mais perto foi uma barraca estranha no bosque a leste de {p} com uma caixa do chá, mas era só de um catador.
Celebrations in Smoke#294.speaker: Festival Attendee

Celebrations in Smoke#295.src: I wish the Kalkalrah clan wouldn't keep the secret so well hidden.
Celebrations in Smoke#295.dst: Queria que o clã Kalkalrah não guardasse tão bem o segredo.
Celebrations in Smoke#295.speaker: Festival Attendee

Celebrations in Smoke#296.src: No, of course not. They keep it a secret, hoarding it up all year, so they can charge us extra during the festival.
Celebrations in Smoke#296.dst: Não, claro que não. Eles guardam segredo e estocam o ano todo para nos cobrar mais caro no festival.
Celebrations in Smoke#296.speaker: Festival Attendee

Celebrations in Smoke#297.src: They do all this under the guise of it being "mystical" and "only suited for ceremonial occasions like this," but everyone sees through their sales techniques.
Celebrations in Smoke#297.dst: Fazem tudo isso com a desculpa de que é "místico" e "só serve para ocasiões cerimoniais como esta", mas todo mundo percebe o truque de vendas.
Celebrations in Smoke#297.speaker: Festival Attendee

Celebrations in Smoke#298.src: ... not that it stops me from buying every bottle I can get my hands on. It feels amazing.
Celebrations in Smoke#298.dst: ... o que não me impede de comprar cada garrafa que encontro. É uma delícia.
Celebrations in Smoke#298.speaker: Festival Attendee

Celebrations in Smoke#300.src: Okay, you have to be holding out on me.
Celebrations in Smoke#300.dst: Tá, você está escondendo algo de mim.
Celebrations in Smoke#300.speaker: Festival Attendee

Celebrations in Smoke#301.src: Come on, give me the name. What do you want, emeralds? Information? I'll give it to you, just tell me where I can find a year round green tea merchant.
Celebrations in Smoke#301.dst: Vamos, me dá o nome. O que você quer, esmeraldas? Informação? Eu dou, só me diga onde achar um mercador de chá verde o ano todo.
Celebrations in Smoke#301.speaker: Festival Attendee

Celebrations in Smoke#302.src: What are you wasting my time for then?
Celebrations in Smoke#302.dst: Então por que me faz perder tempo?
Celebrations in Smoke#302.speaker: Festival Attendee

Celebrations in Smoke#303.src: If you get any leads on that tea trader, make sure to let me know right away.
Celebrations in Smoke#303.dst: Se tiver alguma pista desse comerciante de chá, me avise na hora.
Celebrations in Smoke#303.speaker: Festival Attendee

Celebrations in Smoke#304.src: Are you sure you're a green

Celebrations in Smoke#305.src: You must not have spoken to the people I sold to then.
Celebrations in Smoke#305.dst: Então você não falou com quem comprou de mim.
Celebrations in Smoke#305.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#306.src: Not sure how much of an enthusiast they could be if they don't know me.
Celebrations in Smoke#306.dst: Não sei que tipo de fã de chá é esse, se não me conhece.
Celebrations in Smoke#306.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#307.src: Even so, that's only the words of one person. I won't pretend to know everyone in the {p}. Even the ones I do meet I don't make a major impression on.
Celebrations in Smoke#307.dst: Mesmo assim, é a palavra de uma pessoa só. Não vou fingir que conheço todo mundo em {p}. E quem eu conheço nem sempre se lembra de mim.
Celebrations in Smoke#307.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#310.src: Search for a camp east of {p} [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] that Burick might have been spotted at.
Celebrations in Smoke#310.dst: Procure um acampamento a leste de {p}, em [-{~}, {~}, -{~}], onde Burick pode ter sido visto.

Celebrations in Smoke#312.src: What else would I need? I'm sure while you were violating my privacy you snooped through my stuff. I have nothing to hide.
Celebrations in Smoke#312.dst: Do que mais eu precisaria? Aposto que, invadindo minha privacidade, fuçou nas minhas coisas. Não tenho nada a esconder.
Celebrations in Smoke#312.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#313.src: There simply isn't much excess gear that I need as a merchant.
Celebrations in Smoke#313.dst: Como mercador, não preciso de muito equipamento extra.
Celebrations in Smoke#313.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#314.src: You're not believing that, are you.
Celebrations in Smoke#314.dst: Você não está engolindo isso, né?
Celebrations in Smoke#314.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#315.src: Fine. I'm not really a merchant.
Celebrations in Smoke#315.dst: Certo. Não sou mercador de fato.
Celebrations in Smoke#315.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#316.src: I'm a scavenger. I was born without a clan and have lived my entire life without one.
Celebrations in Smoke#316.dst: Sou um catador. Nasci sem clã e vivi a vida toda sem um.
Celebrations in Smoke#316.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#317.src: When pressed, I pose as a merchant. I've spent enough time wandering the {p} that I have enough knowledge to be one.
Celebrations in Smoke#317.dst: Quando me pressionam, finjo ser mercador. Já vaguei por {p} o bastante para saber como fazer.
Celebrations in Smoke#317.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#318.src: Still though, that's all. I won't pretend I didn't lie to you, but beside that I'm telling the truth.
Celebrations in Smoke#318.dst: Mas é só isso. Não vou fingir que não menti, mas fora isso estou dizendo a verdade.
Celebrations in Smoke#318.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#319.src: I don't know who tried to burn down the wickerman or why. It certainly wasn't me.
Celebrations in Smoke#319.dst: Não sei quem tentou queimar o homem de vime nem por quê. Com certeza não fui eu.
Celebrations in Smoke#319.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#320.src: There's not much to do out in the wilderness. Only so many times I can forage the same bush for food or admire the same river.
Celebrations in Smoke#320.dst: Não há muito o que fazer no meio do mato. Dá para catar comida no mesmo arbusto ou admirar o mesmo rio só até certo ponto.
Celebrations in Smoke#320.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#321.src: I get lonely. I still am lonely.
Celebrations in Smoke#321.dst: Me sinto só. E ainda me sinto.
Celebrations in Smoke#321.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#322.src: The festival is the only time of year I really get to be with others, I've been attending for years now.
Celebrations in Smoke#322.dst: O festival é a única época do ano em que fico com outras pessoas; venho há anos.
Celebrations in Smoke#322.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#323.src: Not that I can speak to anyone much. They might realize I'm not supposed to be here.
Celebrations in Smoke#323.dst: Não que eu possa falar muito com alguém. Podem perceber que eu não devia estar aqui.
Celebrations in Smoke#323.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#324.src: How did you actually get in?
Celebrations in Smoke#324.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#325.src: I've managed to find a spot in the {p} wall where you can leap over and the guards can't see. I'm amazed they haven't fixed it yet.
Celebrations in Smoke#325.dst: Achei um ponto no muro de {p} onde dá para pular sem os guardas verem. Me espanta que ainda não tenham consertado.
Celebrations in Smoke#325.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#326.src: Come to think of it, if someone else was coming here uninvited, that's probably how they got in too.
Celebrations in Smoke#326.dst: Pensando bem, se mais alguém veio sem convite, provavelmente entrou por ali também.
Celebrations in Smoke#326.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#328.src: I found it lying on the ground a few weeks ago, cracked open and half empty.
Celebrations in Smoke#328.dst: Achei no chão umas semanas atrás, rachada e meio vazia.
Celebrations in Smoke#328.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#329.src: Someone must have lost it or something, maybe a patrol of soldiers? That would be odd though, they're usually quite tidy.
Celebrations in Smoke#329.dst: Alguém deve ter perdido, talvez uma patrulha de soldados? Mas seria estranho, eles costumam ser bem cuidadosos.
Celebrations in Smoke#329.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#330.src: It could have been one of the clans too. At least one of them knows how to produce the stuff.
Celebrations in Smoke#330.dst: Também pode ter sido um dos clãs. Pelo menos um deles sabe produzir isso.
Celebrations in Smoke#330.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#331.src: I don't know, but I'm glad I found it! It's been too long since I've managed to drink any.
Celebrations in Smoke#331.dst: Não sei, mas que bom que achei! Fazia tempo demais que eu não bebia nenhum.
Celebrations in Smoke#331.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#332.src: I hope you didn't confiscate it while you were snooping through my home.
Celebrations in Smoke#332.dst: Espero que não tenha confiscado enquanto fuçava na minha casa.
Celebrations in Smoke#332.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#333.src: My parents were exiled, I think?
Celebrations in Smoke#333.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#334.src: I've never really gotten the entirety of that story, so I'm unsure.
Celebrations in Smoke#334.dst: Nunca ouvi essa história inteira, então não tenho certeza.
Celebrations in Smoke#334.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#335.src: I don't really feel like going deeper into it than that.
Celebrations in Smoke#335.dst: Não estou a fim de me aprofundar mais nisso.
Celebrations in Smoke#335.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#336.src: It's nice to meet you too. I'm Cerisa, a petty thief.
Celebrations in Smoke#336.dst: O prazer é meu. Sou Cerisa, uma ladra de pouca monta.

Celebrations in Smoke#337.src: I snuck into the festival to snag shiny trinkets and whatever else I could get my hands on.
Celebrations in Smoke#337.dst: Entrei escondida no festival para pegar bugigangas brilhantes e o que mais eu conseguisse.
Celebrations in Smoke#337.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#338.src: I was also completely uninvolved in who or what tried to burn down the wickerman, so you can let me go whenever you're ready to.
Celebrations in Smoke#338.dst: Também não tive nada a ver com quem ou o que tentou queimar o homem de vime, então pode me soltar quando quiser.
Celebrations in Smoke#338.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#339.src: Did you have anything else you wanted to know?
Celebrations in Smoke#339.dst: Há mais alguma coisa que você queira saber?
Celebrations in Smoke#339.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#341.src: Because you'd figure it out one way or another, I don't have a more respectable occupation to cover it up with that you wouldn't quickly disprove.
Celebrations in Smoke#341.dst: Porque você descobriria de um jeito ou de outro; não tenho uma profissão mais respeitável para disfarçar que você não desmentisse logo.
Celebrations in Smoke#341.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#342.src: It'd be irrational to hide my criminal nature when that is precisely what you're searching for.
Celebrations in Smoke#342.dst: Seria irracional esconder minha natureza criminosa quando é justamente isso que você procura.
Celebrations in Smoke#342.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#343.src: If I deceived you and you found out, you would surely take it as evidence that I had even more to hide.
Celebrations in Smoke#343.dst: Se eu te enganasse e você descobrisse, com certeza veria isso como prova de que escondo ainda mais.
Celebrations in Smoke#343.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#344.src: My solitary purpose right now is to convince you that I did not try to burn the effigy. I can deal with the consequences of being exposed as a thief later.
Celebrations in Smoke#344.dst: Meu único objetivo agora é te convencer de que não tentei queimar a efígie. Lido depois com as consequências de ser exposta como ladra.
Celebrations in Smoke#344.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#345.src: Of course not, that would be contrary to my overall purpose.
Celebrations in Smoke#345.dst: Claro que não, isso iria contra o meu objetivo.
Celebrations in Smoke#345.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#346.src: Mind you, I don't expect you to believe me when I say that. You should definitely act as though I am lying to you.
Celebrations in Smoke#346.dst: Veja bem, não espero que acredite em mim. Você deveria agir como se eu estivesse mentindo.
Celebrations in Smoke#346.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#347.src: But I won't. You trusting me is my best ticket out of this mess.
Celebrations in Smoke#347.dst: Mas não vou. Sua confiança é meu melhor passe para sair dessa.
Celebrations in Smoke#347.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#348.src: I do. I have no idea what they'd do to me and I don't want to find out.
Celebrations in Smoke#348.dst: Sim. Não faço ideia do que fariam comigo e não quero descobrir.
Celebrations in Smoke#348.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#349.src: From what I was able to overhear between you and the organizer, it sounds like you're looking for a changeling.
Celebrations in Smoke#349.dst: Pelo que ouvi da sua conversa com o organizador, parece que você procura um metamorfo.
Celebrations in Smoke#349.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#350.src: And based on what they do to just an effigy of a changeling, I have absolutely no desire to find out what would happen to me if they actually thought I was one.
Celebrations in Smoke#350.dst: E, vendo o que fazem com uma simples efígie de metamorfo, não tenho a menor vontade de descobrir o que fariam comigo se achassem que eu sou um.
Celebrations in Smoke#350.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#351.src: I'll take whatever punishment my thievery gets me and move on.
Celebrations in Smoke#351.dst: Aceito a punição que meus furtos me renderem e sigo em frente.
Celebrations in Smoke#351.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#352.src: Of course, I'll talk about whatever you want.
Celebrations in Smoke#352.dst: Claro, falo sobre o que você quiser.
Celebrations in Smoke#352.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#354.src: Of course. I'll talk about whatever you want.
Celebrations in Smoke#354.dst: Claro. Falo sobre o que você quiser.
Celebrations in Smoke#354.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#355.src: Yes. Being outside of a clan, there's no one particularly trustworthy in the {p}.
Celebrations in Smoke#355.dst: Sim. Fora de um clã, não há ninguém muito confiável em {p}.
Celebrations in Smoke#355.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#356.src: With the changelings, even if I were to find a partner, I don't know how to make medallions and so could never be sure they weren't killed and replaced.
Celebrations in Smoke#356.dst: Com os metamorfos por aí, mesmo que eu achasse um parceiro, não sei fazer medalhões, então nunca teria certeza de que não foi morto e substituído.
Celebrations in Smoke#356.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#357.src: It's much easier this way, I assure you.
Celebrations in Smoke#357.dst: Assim é bem mais fácil, garanto.
Celebrations in Smoke#357.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#359.src: Whoever I can. For the most part it's the clans, they can be shockingly lazy if you know where you're looking.
Celebrations in Smoke#359.dst: De quem eu puder. Na maioria, dos clãs; são incrivelmente descuidados se você souber onde olhar.
Celebrations in Smoke#359.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#360.src: I have stolen a bit from the military when their watch lapses, although that's obviously much harder to pull off.
Celebrations in Smoke#360.dst: Já roubei um pouco do exército quando a vigia relaxa, mas isso é obviamente bem mais difícil.
Celebrations in Smoke#360.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#361.src: Not personally, no. I've heard some rumors though.
Celebrations in Smoke#361.dst: Pessoalmente, não. Mas ouvi alguns boatos.
Celebrations in Smoke#361.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#362.src: Hard to tell fact from fiction, but they certainly seem to be a nasty bunch.
Celebrations in Smoke#362.dst: É difícil separar fato de ficção, mas parecem ser uma gente ruim.
Celebrations in Smoke#362.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#363.src: I wouldn't be surprised to hear one tried to break into the festival.
Celebrations in Smoke#363.dst: Não me surpreenderia se um tentasse invadir o festival.
Celebrations in Smoke#363.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#364.src: Not directly, no. But of the three of us, I was the farthest from where the flame was kindled.
Celebrations in Smoke#364.dst: Diretamente, não. Mas, dos três, eu era a que estava mais longe de onde o fogo começou.
Celebrations in Smoke#364.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#365.src: I may have seen one of the other two suspects move, but I can't be positive about that.
Celebrations in Smoke#365.dst: Talvez eu tenha visto um dos outros dois suspeitos se mexer, mas não posso garantir.
Celebrations in Smoke#365.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#366.src: If I had more information I would of course provide it.
Celebrations in Smoke#366.dst: Se eu soubesse mais, é claro que diria.
Celebrations in Smoke#366.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#367.src: Ah, have you decided to try and play confrontational?
Celebrations in Smoke#367.dst: Ah, resolveu partir para o confronto?
Celebrations in Smoke#367.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#368.src: That's fine, I will reiterate that I didn't do it. Whether you believe me or not, that is the truth.
Celebrations in Smoke#368.dst: Tudo bem, repito que não fui eu. Acredite ou não, essa é a verdade.
Celebrations in Smoke#368.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#369.src: My fate lies entirely in your hands, so to speak. You don't have to engage in theatrics to intimidate me, you are exactly as scary as you were before.
Celebrations in Smoke#369.dst: Meu destino está inteiramente nas suas mãos, por assim dizer. Não precisa de teatro para me intimidar: você assusta exatamente tanto quanto antes.
Celebrations in Smoke#369.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#370.src: Find someone who might have been observant enough to see Cerisa sneak in.
Celebrations in Smoke#370.dst: Encontre alguém atento o bastante para ter visto Cerisa entrar escondida.

Celebrations in Smoke#371.src: Nothing obviously dangerous, but I always keep in mind.
Celebrations in Smoke#371.dst: Nada perigoso à vista, mas nunca baixo a guarda.
Celebrations in Smoke#371.speaker: Festival Attendee

Celebrations in Smoke#372.src: I did see something very odd a few hours ago though. By the entrance to {p}, it looked like someone hopped over the fence.
Celebrations in Smoke#372.dst: Mas vi algo bem estranho umas horas atrás. Perto da entrada de {p}, parecia que alguém pulou a cerca.
Celebrations in Smoke#372.speaker: Festival Attendee

Celebrations in Smoke#373.src: It might have been a trick of the light, but I think I saw them change clothes and shove something under the bridge.
Celebrations in Smoke#373.dst: Pode ter sido ilusão de ótica, mas acho que vi a pessoa trocar de roupa e enfiar algo debaixo da ponte.
Celebrations in Smoke#373.speaker: Festival Attendee

Celebrations in Smoke#374.src: Those might just be the ramblings of a worried old parent though!
Celebrations in Smoke#374.dst: Mas pode ser só coisa de quem já é velho e preocupado!
Celebrations in Smoke#374.speaker: Festival Attendee

Celebrations in Smoke#375.src: Oh really? That's a shame, I thought I was stealthier than that.
Celebrations in Smoke#375.dst: Ah, é? Que pena, achei que eu fosse mais furtiva.
Celebrations in Smoke#375.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#376.src: I'm not sure that's a real revelation though, I've been open to you that that's what I did.
Celebrations in Smoke#376.dst: Mas não sei se isso é revelação; eu te disse abertamente que fiz isso.
Celebrations in Smoke#376.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#377.src: Is there anything else you wanted to call me to account for?
Celebrations in Smoke#377.dst: Há mais alguma coisa que queira me cobrar?
Celebrations in Smoke#377.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#378.src: Yes, I had a change in clothes. The clothes I wear on a daily basis are no fit for a cheerful atmosphere like the festival.
Celebrations in Smoke#378.dst: Sim, eu trouxe uma muda de roupa. A que uso no dia a dia não combina com um clima alegre como o do festival.
Celebrations in Smoke#378.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#379.src: In that case, I appreciate you keeping me up to date on the progress of your investigation. Your commitment to transparency in the judicial process is admirable.
Celebrations in Smoke#379.dst: Nesse caso, agradeço por me manter a par do andamento da sua investigação. Seu compromisso com a transparência no processo judicial é admirável.
Celebrations in Smoke#379.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#380.src: Search under the bridge around [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] for something Cerisa may have left behind.
Celebrations in Smoke#380.dst: Procure debaixo da ponte, perto de [-{~}, {~}, -{~}], algo que Cerisa possa ter deixado.

Celebrations in Smoke#382.src: That would be because it's mine.
Celebrations in Smoke#382.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#383.src: Your investigation is quite impressive, I'll admit. I was not expecting anyone to find those, I must not have disposed of them properly.
Celebrations in Smoke#383.dst: Sua investigação é bem impressionante, admito. Não esperava que alguém achasse aquilo; não devo ter me livrado direito.
Celebrations in Smoke#383.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#384.src: Although you did get a bit lucky, didn't you. If no one had spotted me sneak in, you never would have found them.
Celebrations in Smoke#384.dst: Mas você teve um pouco de sorte, não teve? Se ninguém tivesse me visto entrar escondida, nunca teria achado.
Celebrations in Smoke#384.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#385.src: I am a deserter from the military, as of a couple days ago. My stop here is a temporary respite to steal whatever I can before disappearing into the {p} as far as I can.
Celebrations in Smoke#385.dst: Sou desertora do exército há uns dois dias. Esta parada é uma pausa para roubar o que eu puder antes de sumir em {p} o mais longe possível.
Celebrations in Smoke#385.speaker: Cerisa
